title: Network pharmacology analysis and animal experiment validation of neuroinflammation inhibition by total ginsenoside in treating CSM.
authors: Li, Zhuo-Yao; Dai, Yu-Xiang; Wu, Zi-Ming; Li, Gan; Pu, Pei-Min; Hu, Cai-Wei; Zhou, Long-Yun; Zhu, Ke; Shu, Bing; Wang, Yong-Jun; Cui, Xue-Jun; Yao, Min
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参总皂苷治疗脊髓型颈椎病的网络药理学与动物实验，核心为神经炎症通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical spondylotic myelopathy (CSM) is a degenerative pathology that affects both upper and lower extremity mobility and sensory function, causing significant pressure on patients and society. Prior research has suggested that ginsenosides may have neuroprotective properties in central nervous system diseases. However, the efficacy and mechanism of ginsenosides for CSM have yet to be investigated. PURPOSE: This study aims to analyze the composition of ginsenosides using UPLC-MS, identify the underlying mechanism of ginsenosides in treating CSM using network pharmacology, and subsequently confirm the efficacy and mechanism of ginsenosides in rats with chronic spinal cord compression. METHODS: UPLC-Q-TOF-MS was utilized to obtain mass spectrum data of ginsenoside samples. The chemical constituents of the samples were analyzed by consulting literature reports and relevant databases. Ginsenoside and CSM targets were obtained from the TCMSP, OMIM, and GeneCards databases. GO and KEGG analyses were conducted, and a visualization network of ginsenosides-compounds-key targets-pathways-CSM was constructed, along with molecular docking of key bioactive compounds and targets, to identify the signaling pathways and proteins associated with the therapeutic effects of ginsenosides on CSM. Chronic spinal cord compression rats were intraperitoneally injected with ginsenosides (50 mg/kg and 150 mg/kg) and methylprednisolone for 28 days, and motor function was assessed to investigate the therapeutic efficacy of ginsenosides for CSM. The expression of proteins associated with TNF, IL-17, TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB, and NLRP3 signaling pathways was assessed by immunofluorescence staining and western blotting. RESULTS: Using UPLC-Q-TOF-MS, 37 compounds were identified from ginsenoside samples. Furthermore, ginsenosides-compounds-key targets-pathways-CSM visualization network indicated that ginsenosides may modulate the PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, TNF signaling pathway, MAPK signaling pathway, IL-17 signaling pathway, Toll-like receptor signaling pathway and Apoptosis by targeting AKT1, TNF, MAPK1, CASP3, IL6, and IL1B, exerting a therapeutic effect on CSM. By attenuating neuroinflammation through the TNF, IL-17, TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB, and MAPK signaling pathways, ginsenosides restored the motor function of rats with CSM, and ginsenosides 150 mg/kg showed better effect. This was achieved by reducing the phosphorylation of NF-kappaB and the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome. CONCLUSIONS: The results of network pharmacology indicate that ginsenosides can inhibit neuroinflammation resulting from spinal cord compression through multiple pathways and targets. This finding was validated through in vivo tests, which demonstrated that ginsenosides can reduce neuroinflammation by inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasomes via multiple signaling pathways, additionally, it should be noted that 150 mg/kg was a relatively superior dose. This study is the first to verify the intrinsic molecular mechanism of ginsenosides in treating CSM by combining pharmacokinetics, network pharmacology, and animal experiments. The findings can provide evidence for subsequent clinical research and drug development.
abstract_zh: 背景：脊髓型颈椎病（CSM）是一种退行性病变，影响上下肢活动及感觉功能，给患者和社会带来沉重负担。既往研究表明，人参皂苷在中枢神经系统疾病中可能具有神经保护作用。然而，人参皂苷对CSM的疗效及机制尚未被探讨。目的：本研究旨在利用UPLC-MS分析人参皂苷的组成，通过网络药理学识别人参皂苷治疗CSM的潜在机制，并在慢性脊髓压迫大鼠中进一步确认人参皂苷的疗效及机制。方法：采用UPLC-Q-TOF-MS获取人参皂苷样品的质谱数据。通过查阅文献报道及相关数据库分析样品的化学成分。从TCMSP、OMIM和GeneCards数据库获取人参皂苷及CSM靶点。进行GO和KEGG分析，构建人参皂苷-化合物-关键靶点-通路-CSM的可视化网络，并对关键生物活性化合物与靶点进行分子对接，以识别与人参皂苷治疗CSM效果相关的信号通路和蛋白质。对慢性脊髓压迫大鼠腹腔注射人参皂苷（50 mg/kg和150 mg/kg）及甲泼尼龙，持续28天，评估运动功能以探讨人参皂苷对CSM的治疗效果。通过免疫荧光染色和蛋白质印迹法评估与TNF、IL-17、TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB及NLRP3信号通路相关蛋白的表达。结果：利用UPLC-Q-TOF-MS，从人参皂苷样品中鉴定出37种化合物。此外，人参皂苷-化合物-关键靶点-通路-CSM可视化网络表明，人参皂苷可能通过靶向AKT1、TNF、MAPK1、CASP3、IL6和IL1B，调节PI3K-Akt信号通路、TNF信号通路、MAPK信号通路、IL-17信号通路、Toll样受体信号通路及凋亡，从而对CSM发挥治疗作用。通过TNF、IL-17、TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB及MAPK信号通路减轻神经炎症，人参皂苷恢复了CSM大鼠的运动功能，且150 mg/kg剂量效果更佳。这一效果通过减少NF-kappaB的磷酸化及NLRP3炎症小体的激活实现。结论：网络药理学结果表明，人参皂苷可通过多条通路和多个靶点抑制脊髓压迫引起的神经炎症。这一发现通过体内实验得到验证，证明人参皂苷可通过多条信号通路抑制NLRP3炎症小体来减轻神经炎症，此外，150 mg/kg为相对较优剂量。本研究首次结合药代动力学、网络药理学及动物实验，验证了人参皂苷治疗CSM的内在分子机制。该发现可为后续临床研究及药物开发提供依据。
